automation_boundary.automated_scope: Login page -> Click 'e& Password' tab -> Fill Username or Email -> Fill Password -> Optional 'Remember me' toggle -> Click SIGN IN -> Navigate to Organization Selection or authenticated Dashboard 360.
automation_boundary.external_boundary: Forgot password email reset link processing is external. Live authentication assumes valid test credentials configured in the environment.

canonical_steps.action: Navigate to the B2B Portal login page
canonical_steps.expected_result: The login page loads displaying the authentication tab options

canonical_steps.action: Click the 'e& Password' tab to switch to password-based login
canonical_steps.expected_result: The password authentication form is rendered showing Username, Password, Remember Me, and Sign In

canonical_steps.action: Enter the registered username or email address
Enter the account password in the password field
canonical_steps.expected_result: The password field is populated with masked characters

canonical_steps.action: Optionally select the Remember me checkbox to retain login credentials
canonical_steps.expected_result: The Remember me checkbox is checked

canonical_steps.action: Click the SIGN IN button to authenticate
canonical_steps.expected_result: Credentials are submitted, and user is routed to Organization Selection or the Dashboard

canonical_steps.action: Select the target organization if prompted on multi-organization screen
canonical_steps.expected_result: The organization is chosen and Dashboard 360 loads

canonical_steps.action: Verify the authenticated B2B Portal Dashboard is displayed
canonical_steps.expected_result: The authenticated dashboard is visible with user details and account summaries

test_data_notes.toggle_visibility: The eye icon button (button.password-toggle) toggles input type between 'password' and 'text'.
